paragraphs.text: The Rag Man or Ragman was a minion created by Lord Ith during The Dark Age on Dominaria .
The Rag Man had slender, bony fingers and kind black eyes. He had the face of a boy, lined with age, and a soft voice. It was believed that his touch could take one's soul.
Around 300 AR , a Rag Man was active in the Bade Mountains of northern Aerona . He fathered children on the women of a village, and these children grew up to become Rag Men themselves.

Over a century later, Lord Ith, imprisoned by his apprentice Mairsil , summoned a Rag Man. This Rag Man led Jodah to the Conclave of Mages . Jodah freed the old mage, only to see Ith, who had been driven insane, go into a murderous rampage that resulted in the death of Mairsil and the Rag Man, and the Fall of the Conclave of Mages . In the end, Jodah managed to make Ith come to his senses. The artificer Barl , who had devised the cage that had held Ith, was turned into Ith's new Rag Man.
When first printed in The Dark , Rag Man had the unique Creature type of Rag-Man . This was given errata in Seventh Edition to be Minion , and later further given errata in Oracle to include Human .
